title: Turning tracking back on shows the count as it stands now
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 4 in bin location A and 3 in bin location B, turn its tracking off, then change bin location A's quantity to 1 while it is untracked.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch off, and the bins show bin location A with 1 and bin location B with 3.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns on and the bins still show the quantities as they stand now: 1 and 3, not the 4 and 3 held when tracking was turned off.

Step 3:

  • Part A's Total Qty reads 4 Available (1 + 3 = 4), not 7.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-R6: “Turning tracking on shows the count as it stands.”
  • Key Decisions: “Turning tracking off only hides the count. Nothing is cleared and nothing is written off, so there is nothing to confirm. Turning tracking back on shows the count as it stands. Clearing stock while the accounting kept moving it would count the same cost twice.”
